summary: Submitted the fixed mixed-suffrage experiment for the commit-eligibility question: one process with two real Voters (quorum 2) plus one fully caught-up real Nonvoter, applying one command while the Nonvoter is withheld and one while a Voter is withheld, emitting the leader's last log index, the leader's commit index and the nonvoter's last log index as independent operands. Native construction feedback with identical inputs showed mode A committing with the Nonvoter withheld (leader_commit 3->4) and mode B leaving leader_commit at 4 while the Nonvoter had stored entry 5 and the apply returned 'leadership lost while committing log', i.e. a nonvoter acknowledgement did not advance commitIndex; the measured interpretation is left for the retained controller receipt. Added supporting sources for commitment.match plus the replication/quorum/lease voter-only sets.
